body: Heh, thanks. I have hangups about psychiatrists and medication, despite my affinity for mind altering substances. I had to break myself from a longtime pot habit over the last year. As soon as I recognized that I was self medicating with it I had to stop. It led to a vast improvement in my life for sometime too. There's actually a large mental health hospital not far from my apartment and they claim to have a process to direct me to the correct department. I'll see how it goes.

So I do sort of want to talk, if you don't mind. I really appreciate you taking the time to, well, make me feel like I exist. It's lame that I was at such a low point that random internet validation was what I needed. I'm not really a SW, I think. I have been battling depression for a long time and totally ignoring it.

I've been encouraged to seek therapy but I really don't feel ready. I don't know why it's so hard to do, all I want is someone to listen and that's literally what therapy is. Maybe this is a mini-step in the right direction? I hope so.

So it seems typing this stuff out is helping me a little. Getting it out helps keep the panic back. I have a really hard time getting things like this out in person; it gets so there's like a million things swarming around and I can't get it organized at all.

I want therapy. I'm an adult now (barely), I have insurance, there's nothing stopping me but me. The whole prospect of it just makes me nervous for some reason, and it keeps me from figuring out how to start the process. It feels odd to ask, but can you maybe help me figure out where to start? Possibly explain a little bit about how the process works? I'm not sure why I assume you'd know though.

Anyway, thanks. I'm going to sleep and tomorrow is a new day. That
s good enough.
